speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have swelling in your right knee and a family history of similar issues; to start, how old are you and how long have you been experiencing this swelling?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (X-linked bleeding disorder). The patient's age, spontaneous onset of knee swelling without trauma, and family history strongly suggest a hereditary bleeding diathesis rather than trauma or infection. I would confirm this with a REQUEST TEST: PTT and PT/INR to evaluate coagulation times.
